verses.t: “Nagā nagaggesu susaṁvirūḷhā, Udaggameghena navena sittā; Vivekakāmassa araññasaññino, Janeti bhiyyo usabhassa kalyatan”ti. … Usabho thero … vaggo ekādasamo.
Belaṭṭhāniko setuccho, Bandhuro khitako isi; Malitavambho suhemanto, Dhammasavo dhammasavapitā; Saṅgharakkhitatthero ca, Usabho ca mahāmunīti.
